x: The other competitors, however, were over half a mile ahead and consisted of Kilby (Coventry)Bullivant(Derby) Tim Johnston (Portsmouth) and Price (Bristol) - hardly the four that Bill would have selected to have given such a start over a 6 mile leg.

Halton, Geoff finished second to Briault in the Sefton Brancker Trophy match between the Civil Service, Middlesex and the R.A.F In leading the Civil Service team to victory Geoff easily beat Price, Pugh, Presland, Barratt, Cooper, Ellis, Entwistle, Mellor, Lindsell and Holts.

Next came Gerry North who has now returned to something like his normal form and when we arrived in Weston were up to 5th, Gerry having displaced Small Heath and Bristol, the latter being represented by Price who had a few weeks earlier passed Gerry in the Walton Relay.
